blocks.text: 14.2.6 mein humne sirf yeh dekha ke angle \(90^{\circ}\) hai ya nahin. Ab hum kisi bhi do vectors ke darmiyan asal angle nikalna seekhenge. Is ke liye koi naya formula yaad nahin karna; dot product ki definition ko hi ulta kar ke \(\cos\theta\) nikaal lete hain.

Do vectors \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) ke darmiyan angle dot product ki definition se maloom kiya jata hai:

(a)
\[\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v} = |\underline{u}||\underline{v}|\cos\theta,\quad 0 \le \theta \le \pi\]
\[\Rightarrow \cos\theta = \dfrac{\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v}}{|\underline{u}||\underline{v}|}\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kyun: definition mein \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v}\), \(|\underline{u}|\) aur \(|\underline{v}|\) teeno components se nikal aate hain; sirf \(\cos\theta\) maloom nahin. To dono taraf ko \(|\underline{u}||\underline{v}|\) se divide kar diya. Yeh divide karna jaaiz hai kyun ke non-zero vectors ki lambaiyan zero nahin hotin.

(b) Agar \(\underline{u} = a_{1}\underline{i} + b_{1}\underline{j} + c_{1}\underline{k}\) aur \(\underline{v} = a_{2}\underline{i} + b_{2}\underline{j} + c_{2}\underline{k}\) hon, to
\[\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v} = a_{1}a_{2} + b_{1}b_{2} + c_{1}c_{2}\]
\[|\underline{u}| = \sqrt{a_{1}^{2} + b_{1}^{2} + c_{1}^{2}}\]
\[|\underline{v}| = \sqrt{a_{2}^{2} + b_{2}^{2} + c_{2}^{2}}\]
\[\because\ \cos\theta = \dfrac{\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v}}{|\underline{u}||\underline{v}|}\]
\(\therefore\)

blocks.text_alt: cos theta equals a 1 a 2 plus b 1 b 2 plus c 1 c 2, over the square root of a 1 squared plus b 1 squared plus c 1 squared times the square root of a 2 squared plus b 2 squared plus c 2 squared

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Angle nikalne ka nuskha (recipe), chaar qadam:
1. Components se \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v}\) nikaalein.
2. \(|\underline{u}|\) aur \(|\underline{v}|\) nikaalein.
3. Divide kar ke \(\cos\theta\) layein.
4. \(0\) aur \(\pi\) ke darmiyan \(\theta\) dhoondein. \(\cos\theta\) positive ho to angle acute, negative ho to obtuse.
Is tarteeb se kaam karein to ghalti ka imkaan bohat kam ho jata hai, aur har qadam alag check bhi ho sakta hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Hamari practice, kitab ka sawal nahin.) \(\underline{i} + \underline{j}\) aur \(\underline{i}\) ke darmiyan angle:
\[\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v} = 1,\quad |\underline{u}| = \sqrt{2},\quad |\underline{v}| = 1\]
\[\cos\theta = \tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \Rightarrow \theta = \tfrac{\pi}{4}\]
Yeh samajh mein bhi aata hai: \(\underline{i} + \underline{j}\) bilkul \(x\) aur \(y\) axes ke beech diagonal hai, yani \(x\)-axis se \(45^{\circ}\) par.

blocks.title: Example 12
blocks.problem: Find the angle between the vectors \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + \underline{k}\) and \(\underline{v} = -\underline{i} + \underline{j}\).
steps:
Given: \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = -\underline{i} + \underline{j} + 0\underline{k}\).
To find: in ke darmiyan angle \(\theta\).
Method: formula \(\cos\theta = \frac{\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v}}{|\underline{u}||\underline{v}|}\). Teen cheezein chahiye: dot product (upar), aur dono lambaiyan (neeche). Ghor karein: \(\underline{v}\) mein \(\underline{k}\) nahin hai, is liye us ka \(\underline{k}\) component \(0\) likh lete hain, taa ke teeno components saamne rahein.

Step 1: Dot product
\[\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v} = (2)(-1) + (-1)(1) + (1)(0)\]
\[= -2 - 1 + 0 = -3\]
Kyun: component formula. Jawab negative aaya, is liye pehle hi pata chal gaya ke angle obtuse (\(90^{\circ}\) se bara) hoga.

Step 2: Lambaiyan
\[|\underline{u}| = \sqrt{(2)^{2} + (-1)^{2} + (1)^{2}} = \sqrt{6}\]
\[|\underline{v}| = \sqrt{(-1)^{2} + (1)^{2} + (0)^{2}} = \sqrt{2}\]
Kyun: magnitude components ke squares ke jor ka square root hai. Square karne se minus khatam ho jata hai: \((-1)^{2} = 1\).

Step 3: \(\cos\theta\)
\[\cos\theta = \dfrac{-3}{\sqrt{6} \cdot \sqrt{2}} = \dfrac{-3}{\sqrt{12}}\]
\[= \dfrac{-3}{2\sqrt{3}} = -\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{6}\sqrt{2} = \sqrt{12} = 2\sqrt{3}\), aur \(\frac{3}{\sqrt{3}} = \sqrt{3}\) (kyun ke \(3 = \sqrt{3} \cdot \sqrt{3}\)). Kitab yeh chhote qadam chhor deti hai.

Step 4: Angle
\[\theta = \dfrac{5\pi}{6}\]
Kyun: \(\cos\frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) hum jaante hain. Cosine negative hai, aur \(0\) se \(\pi\) ke darmiyan cosine sirf doosre quadrant mein negative hota hai. Is liye \(\theta = \pi - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{5\pi}{6}\), yani \(150^{\circ}\).

Tasdeeq:
\(\cos 150^{\circ} = -\cos 30^{\circ} = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\). Aur \(150^{\circ}\) obtuse hai, bilkul jaisa negative dot product ne pehle hi bata diya tha.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Example 12 mein \(\underline{v}\) ki jagah \(-\underline{v} = \underline{i} - \underline{j}\) le lein to angle kya hoga? Sochiye: dot product ka sign ulat jayega, \(\cos\theta = +\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\), aur angle \(\frac{\pi}{6}\) ho jayega. Yani vector ulat dene se angle \(\theta\) se \(\pi - \theta\) ban jata hai.

blocks.title: Example 13
blocks.problem: Show that the vectors \(2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{i} - 3\underline{j} - 5\underline{k}\) and \(3\underline{i} - 4\underline{j} - 4\underline{k}\) are the sides of a right triangle.
steps:
Given: teen vectors.
To prove: yeh ek triangle banate hain, aur us triangle mein ek right angle hai.
Method: do kaam karne hain. Pehla: sides ka naam \(\overrightarrow{AB}\), \(\overrightarrow{BC}\), \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) rakh kar dikhana ke \(\overrightarrow{AB} + \overrightarrow{BC} = \overrightarrow{AC}\); tab yeh teeno ek band triangle banate hain. Doosra: kisi do sides ka dot product \(0\) dikhana; tab un ke darmiyan \(90^{\circ}\) hai.

Step 1: Sides ke naam
\[\overrightarrow{AB} = 2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + \underline{k}\]
\[\overrightarrow{BC} = \underline{i} - 3\underline{j} - 5\underline{k}\]
\[\overrightarrow{AC} = 3\underline{i} - 4\underline{j} - 4\underline{k}\]
Kyun: pehle do vectors ko jama kar ke dekhte hain ke kya teesra mil jata hai; agar haan, to \(A\) se \(B\), phir \(B\) se \(C\), seedha \(A\) se \(C\) ke barabar hai.

Step 2: Triangle banta hai
\[\overrightarrow{AB} + \overrightarrow{BC} = (2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + \underline{k}) + (\underline{i} - 3\underline{j} - 5\underline{k})\]
\[= 3\underline{i} - 4\underline{j} - 4\underline{k} = \overrightarrow{AC}\]
Kyun: triangle law of addition: agar \(\overrightarrow{AB} + \overrightarrow{BC} = \overrightarrow{AC}\) ho to teeno vectors triangle \(ABC\) ki sides hain. Components alag alag jama kiye: \(2 + 1 = 3\), \(-1 - 3 = -4\), \(1 - 5 = -4\).

Step 3: Right angle dhoondein
\[\overrightarrow{AB} \cdot \overrightarrow{BC} = (2)(1) + (-1)(-3) + (1)(-5)\]
\[= 2 + 3 - 5 = 0\]
\[\therefore\ \overrightarrow{AB} \perp \overrightarrow{BC}\]
Kyun: non-zero vectors ka dot product zero hai, is liye yeh perpendicular hain. \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) aur \(\overrightarrow{BC}\) point \(B\) par milte hain, is liye right angle \(B\) par hai (figure dekhiye).

Tasdeeq:
Pythagoras se dekhte hain: \(|\overrightarrow{AB}|^{2} = 4 + 1 + 1 = 6\), \(|\overrightarrow{BC}|^{2} = 1 + 9 + 25 = 35\), \(|\overrightarrow{AC}|^{2} = 9 + 16 + 16 = 41\). Aur \(6 + 35 = 41\). Bilkul sahi!
blocks.answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(\Delta ABC\) right triangle hai, aur right angle \(B\) par hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\cos\theta = \frac{\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v}}{|\underline{u}||\underline{v}|}\), aur \(0 \le \theta \le \pi\).
2. Components mein: upar dot product, neeche dono lambaiyon ka product.
3. Teen vectors triangle banate hain agar ek baqi do ka jor ho; right triangle tab jab do sides ka dot product \(0\) ho.
4. Negative \(\cos\theta\) ka matlab obtuse angle.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(\cos\theta\) negative hone par bhi acute angle likh dena: \(-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) ka angle \(\frac{5\pi}{6}\) hai, \(\frac{\pi}{6}\) nahin.
2. Lambaiyon ka product ghalat: \(\sqrt{6} \cdot \sqrt{2} = \sqrt{12}\), \(\sqrt{8}\) nahin. Square roots ke andar wale numbers multiply hote hain.
3. Example 13 jaise sawal mein sirf right angle dikha dena aur yeh bhool jana ke pehle triangle banna saabit karna hai.
4. Missing component (jaise \(\underline{v}\) mein \(\underline{k}\)) ko chhor kar ghalat jagah multiply kar dena; pehle \(0\underline{k}\) likh lein.
